items.text: The NIFTY 500 rose 0.4% on 12 Nov. Realty was the strongest sector (+1.1%) and Textiles the weakest (−0.2%).

Foreign investors bought a net ₹13,113 Cr of Indian shares in 16-31 Oct 2026, after selling ₹47,956 Cr in 1-15 Oct 2026. Foreign investors are quietly accumulating in 46 niches; Cables, Wires & Conductors and Construction & Earthmoving Equipment joined today.
